Planning a trip to Poland next year? Build it around one day.

The day in the village is the reason for the trip, so plan everything else around it:
🔹 arrive nearby the evening before
🔹 give the parish office and the cemetery a full morning
🔹 leave the afternoon free for the relatives you may meet
🔹 keep the next day open, because villages rarely run on schedule

Going Back to Poland has a 7-day and a 10-day route, both shaped around that one day.
